tiers.text: White's queen is deep on your side of the board. Is it safe there?
Can you attack the queen so it runs out of safe squares?
Your bishop is the piece to use.
Bb7 attacks the queen. It has to run, and it doesn't have many places to go.
The queen ran to a7. Which squares can it still go to?
Attack the queen again. It is almost trapped!
Your rook is the piece to use.
Ra8 attacks the queen and it has no safe square left. The best White can do is take your rook.
White's queen just took your rook. Can you take it back?
Capture the piece that just took yours.
Your bishop is the piece to use.
Bxa8 wins the queen. You gave up a rook (5) and won a queen (9)!
